camera.shot_scale_bias: wide illustrative compositions with generous empty paper
camera.height: eye level, flat to the page

lens.dof: everything equally in focus, with depth carried by wash density

sources: diffuse light with no single source
lighting.practicals: shadow is painted as a cooler wash rather than an absence of light

palette.grade: soft translucent layers on visible paper texture

rules: visible paper grain and pigment pooling at the edges of strokes
loose ink outlines that overshoot the fill
composition.movement_of_subject: movement is gentle and rounded, without sharp accelerations

sound.ambience_bias: quiet room tone with soft natural detail

music.instrumentation: A solo celesta with light harp arpeggios
music.dynamics: gentle and even, thinning to a single line at the end

must_include: hand-painted watercolour with visible paper texture and pigment pooling
loose ink linework that does not perfectly follow the colour fill

notes: Translucent washes on textured paper with loose ink lines. Depth comes from layering pigment, not from focus.
